# INZON Times and Gifts

> INZON Times and Gifts is a B2B wholesale supplier and private label partner for custom-branded corporate gifts, promotional merchandise and decor items in Kerala, India. INZON sources products from manufacturers and suppliers, brands gifts with your logo, and supplies gifts and decor in bulk to companies and institutions. Minimum order quantity is 100 units. Delivery covers all of Kerala.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.inzongifting.com/): Who INZON is, what it supplies, who it serves, and how to request a quote.
- [About](https://www.inzongifting.com/about/): Company background, how INZON works as a supplier, the decor items vertical, and contact details.
- [All products](https://www.inzongifting.com/products/): Catalogue of 144 products. Corporate gifts: gift sets, bottles and flasks, bags, apparel, caps, pens, keychains, wall clocks, study tables and home accessories that can be branded.
- [Decor items](https://www.inzongifting.com/products/#decor): Wall art and mirrors, macrame wall hangings, table decor, table lamps, artificial plants, planters and vases, key holders, and storage and organisers.
- [Blog](https://www.inzongifting.com/blog/): Practical buying guides for corporate gifts in bulk.
- [Employee onboarding kits guide](https://www.inzongifting.com/blog/employee-onboarding-kits-kerala/): What to put in a welcome kit for 100+ new joiners, how to brand it and how far ahead to order.

## Ordering facts
- Buyers: companies and institutions ordering in bulk (not individual consumers)
- Minimum order quantity: 100 units
- Payment terms: 100% before delivery
- Delivery area: all Kerala
- Invoicing: GST invoice (GSTIN 32ABRFM8059P1ZC)
